Subject: QBR prep — account-level forecast cleanup & consolidated deck inputs

Team — putting this thread together to lock down the account-level inputs we need for the QBR deck. Target deliverable: a single consolidated deck with one slide per named account + a forecast rollup for the leadership readout.

Ask: please update the attached account_rollup_template_v2.xlsx for your owned accounts and upload to the shared QBR folder by EOD Friday (Oct 2). Key fields we need: current ARR, renewal date, committed vs best-case flags, top 3 risks, and recommended ask/next step.

Notes:
- Use the ‘committed’ flag only if there is a signed PO or contractual commitment.
- If there are open procurement questions (SOC2 evidence, data residency), flag them in the risks column and add the contact name.
- Include any upcoming exec touchpoints (date + outcome expected).

I’ve attached the template and a draft deck placeholder (QBR_consolidated_deck_draft.pptx). POV: we’ll run a 30-minute sweep on Monday (Oct 5) to align on accounts that need leadership attention.

If you can’t meet the EOD Fri deadline, tell me what you’ll be able to deliver and when.

Thanks —
Kimberly
